scriptLines:
query: 'SELECT [CRIS No]
      ,a.[Accession]
      ,[Ref Src]
      ,a.[Site]
      ,[Request Date]
      ,[Event Date]
      ,[Event Time]
      ,[On Call]
      ,[PT]
      ,[Examination]
      ,[Exam Name]
      ,[Room]
      ,[Start Time]
      ,[End Time]
      ,a.[Exam Key]
      ,a.[Event Key]
      ,a.[Status Code]
      ,[Booked Date]
      ,[Booked Time]
      ,[Creation Date]
      ,[Attended]
      ,a.[Urg]
      ,a.[Modality]
      ,[No of Proc]
      ,[Planned Appointment Date]
      ,[Date First Verified]
      ,[Time First Verified]
      ,[Was Planned]
      ,[Was Scheduled]
      ,[Was Waiting]
      ,a.[Stat Date]
      ,[Reported By]
      ,a.[Rank]
      ,[Age At Event]
      ,CONCAT(a.[Site],[Room]) as [ExamSite Code]
      ,b.[Status Code] as [Status Code.2]
      ,b.[Status Date] as [Status Date.1]
      ,Cast(b.[Status Time] as varchar) as [Status Time]
      ,Case When a.[Modality] = 'R' then 'Plain X-Ray'
            When a.[Modality] = 'A' then 'IR' 
            When a.[Modality] = 'B' then 'Mammo' 
            When a.[Modality] = 'C' then 'CT' 
            When a.[Modality] = 'M' then 'MRI' 
            When a.[Modality] = 'F' then 'Fluoro' 
            When a.[Modality] = 'U' then 'NOUS'  
            When a.[Modality] = 'N' then 'Nuc Med' 
            When a.[Modality] = 'S' then 'DEXA'
            When a.[Modality] = 'Z' then 'Additional Workload' 
            When a.[Modality] = 'H' then 'Cardio' 
            When a.[Modality] = 'D' then 'Doppler' 
            When a.[Modality] = 'E' then 'Endo'
            When a.[Modality] = 'Y' then 'Med Phys' 
            When a.[Modality] = 'O' then 'Obstetrics' 
            else 'other' end  as [Modality2]
        ,Case   when a.[Site] = '5HA16' then 'LUHFT' 
                When a.[Site] = '5NL93' then 'LUHFT' 
                When LEFT(a.[Site],3) = 'REM' then 'LUHFT' 
                When LEFT(a.[Site],3) = 'RQ6' then 'LUHFT' 
                When LEFT(a.[Site],3) = 'RBL' then 'WUTH' 
                When LEFT(a.[Site],3) = 'RBN' then 'STHK' 
                When LEFT(a.[Site],3) = 'RBQ' then 'LHCH' 
                When LEFT(a.[Site],3) = 'RBS' then 'Alder Hey' 
                When LEFT(a.[Site],3) = 'RBT' then 'MCH' 
                When LEFT(a.[Site],3) = 'REN' then 'CCC' 
                When LEFT(a.[Site],3) = 'REP' then 'Womens' 
                When LEFT(a.[Site],3) = 'RET' then 'TWC' 
                When LEFT(a.[Site],3) = 'RJR' then 'COCH' 
                When LEFT(a.[Site],3) = 'RVY' then 'S&O' 
                When LEFT(a.[Site],3) = 'RWW' then 'WHH' 
        else a.[Site] end as [Trust Name]
        ,Case   When a.[PT] = 'A' then 'In Patient' 
                When a.[PT] = 'B' then 'Out Patient' 
                When a.[PT] = 'C' then 'A&E Attender' 
                When a.[PT] = 'D' then 'Out Patient' 
                When a.[PT] = 'E' then 'Out Patient' 
                When a.[PT] = 'F' then 'Other' 
                When a.[PT] = 'G' then 'GP Direct Access Patient'  
                When a.[PT] = 'H' then 'In Patient' 
                When a.[PT] = 'J' then 'A&E Attender' 
                When a.[PT] = 'K' then 'Tertiary Referral' 
                When a.[PT] = 'N' then 'In Patient' 
                When a.[PT] = 'R' then 'Research' 
                When a.[PT] = 'T' then 'Dental' 
                When a.[Modality] = 'X' then 'Other' 
                else 'Other' end as [Patient_Type]
        ,Case   When (a.[Modality]='C' or a.[Modality]='M' or a.[Modality]='F' or a.[Modality]='N' or a.[Modality]='S') and (a.[PT]='A' and a.[urg]='5') then 'Urgent Inpatients'
                When (a.[Modality]='C' or a.[Modality]='M' or a.[Modality]='F' or a.[Modality]='N' or a.[Modality]='S' or a.[Modality]='R') and (a.[PT]='C') then 'Emergency Department'
                When (a.[Modality]='R') and (a.[PT]='C') and (Cast([Time First Verified] as int)>=800) and (Cast([Time First Verified] as int)<2000) then 'Emergency Department'
                When a.[Modality]='R' and a.[PT]='C' and (cast([Time First Verified] as int)<800 or cast([Time First Verified]as int)>=2000) then 'Urgent Inpatients'
                When (a.[Modality]='C' or a.[Modality]='M' or a.[Modality]='F' or a.[Modality]='N' or a.[Modality]='S' or a.[Modality]='R') and (a.[PT]='A' and (a.[urg]<>'5')) then 'Non-Urgent Inpatients' 
                When (a.[Modality]='C' or a.[Modality]='M' or a.[Modality]='R' or a.[Modality]='F' or a.[Modality]='N' or a.[Modality]='S') and (a.[PT]='B' or a.[PT]='G') and a.[urg]='7' then 'Outpatient Faster Diagnosis Standard Cancer Pathway'
                When (a.[Modality]='C' or a.[Modality]='M' or a.[Modality]='F' or a.[Modality]='N' or a.[Modality]='S' or a.[Modality]='R') and (a.[PT]='B' or a.[PT]='G' or a.[PT]='D') and (a.[urg]='5') then 'Urgent GP and Outpatients'
                When (a.[Modality]='C' or a.[Modality]='M' or a.[Modality]='R' or a.[Modality]='F' or a.[Modality]='N' or a.[Modality]='S') and (a.[PT]='B' or a.[PT]='D' or a.[PT]='G') and a.[urg]='1' then 'Routine GP and Outpatients' 
                When a.[Modality]='U' or a.[Modality]='A' then 'Ultrasound and Interventional Radiology' else 'Other' end as [Tat Type]
        ,Case   When (a.[Status Code]='ASACK' 
                   or a.[Status Code]='ASRMS' 
                   or a.[Status Code]='ASRQS' 
                   or a.[Status Code]='ATN' 
                   or  a.[Status Code]='ATP' 
                   or a.[Status Code]='CHBU' 
                   or  a.[Status Code]='CHE' 
                   or a.[Status Code]='CHEC' 
                   or a.[Status Code]='CPC' 
                   or a.[Status Code]='CPDNA' 
                   or a.[Status Code]='CPMP' 
                   or a.[Status Code]='CPPG' 
                   or a.[Status Code]='CPPR' 
                   or a.[Status Code]='CPR'
                   or a.[Status Code]='DVR' 
                   or a.[Status Code]='PRTRPT') then 1 else 0 end as [Activity.1]
        ,Case   When (a.[Status Code]='ASACK' 
                   or a.[Status Code]='ASRMS' 
                   or a.[Status Code]='ASRQS' 
                   or a.[Status Code]='ATN' 
                   or  a.[Status Code]='ATP' 
                   or a.[Status Code]='CHBU' 
                   or  a.[Status Code]='CHE' 
                   or a.[Status Code]='CHEC' 
                   or a.[Status Code]='CPC' 
                   or a.[Status Code]='CPDNA' 
                   or a.[Status Code]='CPMP' 
                   or a.[Status Code]='CPPG' 
                   or a.[Status Code]='CPPR' 
                   or a.[Status Code]='CPR'
                   or a.[Status Code]='DVR' 
                   or a.[Status Code]='PRTRPT') then 1 else 0 end as [Count of Activty_Demand for Activity.1]
  FROM (SELECT [CRIS No]
      ,[Accession]
      ,[Ref Src]
      ,Case
      When [Site] is null then 'NULL' else [Site] end as [Site]
      ,cast([Request Date] as date) as [Request Date]
      ,cast([Event Date] as date) as [Event Date]
      ,[Event Time]
      ,[On Call]
      ,[PT]
      ,[Examination]
      ,[Exam Name]
      ,Case
      When [Room] is null then 'NULL' else Room end as [Room]
      ,[Start Time]
      ,[End Time]
      ,[Exam Key]
      ,[Event Key]
      ,[Status Code]
      ,[Booked Date]
      ,[Booked Time]
      ,[Creation Date]
      ,[Attended]
      ,[Urg]
      ,[Modality]
      ,[No of Proc]
      ,[Planned Appointment Date]
      ,[Date First Verified]
      ,[Time First Verified]
      ,[Was Planned]
      ,[Was Scheduled]
      ,[Was Waiting]
      ,[Stat Date]
      ,[Reported By]
      ,[Rank]
      ,[Age At Event]
  FROM [dev].[AzureSqlCOREStageStep1]
  ) as a
  left join [dev].[RequestRecievedStatus] as b on a.[Exam Key]=b.[Exam Key]
',
{Count of Activty_Demand for Activity.1} as long,
